excerpt: How to Reduce Employee Turnover and Increase Employee Retention Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Internships are more than just a way for students and recent graduates to gain experience—they are a powerful recruitment tool for companies looking to hire top talent. With nearly 52% of interns becoming full-time employees at their internship company after graduation, and statistics showing that completing an internship makes you 85% more likely to secure a full-time job, it’s clear that a well-designed internship program can be a win-win for both employers and interns.
author: Anuj Sengar
